title: Joan of Naples Celebrated Crimes
author: Alexandre Dumas

authorInfo.bio: Alexandre Dumas (1824–1895) is the credited author of this historical edition. Works available in this collection include Twenty years after, Camille (La Dame aux Camilias), The Hero of the People: A Historical Romance of Love, Liberty and Loyalty. The linked author record provides further bibliographic details.

description: "Joan of Naples" by Alexandre Dumas is a historical novel set in the early 20th century, chronicling the tumultuous reign of Joan of Naples during the 14th century. The story unfolds against the backdrop of political intrigue and personal conflict following the death of King Robert of Anjou, highlighting Joan's struggle to claim her rightful place as queen amid competing ambitions and treacherous factions within the court.
